mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_qualification_decision(decision_id, case_id, role_type, role_id, qualification_type, decision_source, outcome, valid_from, decided_by, decided_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.decisionId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.roleType}, #{row.roleId}, #{row.qualificationType}, #{row.decisionSource}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.validFrom}, #{row.decidedBy}, #{row.decidedTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT decision_id AS decisionId, case_id AS caseId, role_type AS roleType, role_id AS roleId, qualification_type AS qualificationType, decision_source AS decisionSource, outcome, valid_from AS validFrom, decided_by AS decidedBy, decided_time AS decidedTime, create_time AS createTime FROM t_qualification_decision WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND decision_version IS NULL
